adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler decrypts `reqBody.keys` and immediately does `JSON.parse(...)` and persists the result directly as `credential.key` in both `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: keys } })` and `prisma.credential.create({ data: { key: keys, ... } })`. There is no Zod schema (or other) validation of the decrypted JSON shape/size before storing it, so malformed/unexpected payloads can be persisted and later break code paths that assume a specific credential structure; additionally `JSON.parse` can throw and yield a 500 since it isn't caught.
